test_finalize_called: test that NDFrame.__finalize__ propagates attrs through pandas methods like take, repeat, reset_index, and reindex
test_binops: test binary operators preserve attrs on Series and DataFrame operands with left, right, or both annotation modes
test_string_method: test string accessor methods like contains, replace, and extract propagate attrs through the .str accessor
test_datetime_method: test datetime accessor methods like to_period, tz_localize, and strftime propagate attrs through the .dt accessor
test_datetime_property: test datetime accessor properties like year, month, day, and hour propagate attrs through the .dt accessor
test_timedelta_property: test timedelta accessor properties like days, seconds, and components propagate attrs through the .dt accessor
test_timedelta_methods: test timedelta accessor methods like total_seconds propagate attrs through the .dt accessor
test_groupby_finalize: test groupby aggregation methods like sum, apply, and agg propagate attrs on Series and DataFrame inputs
test_finalize_frame_series_name: test that DataFrame column named name does not leak into the resulting Series name attribute
test_merge_correctly_sets_duplication_al: test merge operations combine allows_duplicate_labels flags from both input DataFrames using AND logic
test_merge_asof_correctly_sets_duplicati: test merge_asof operations combine allows_duplicate_labels flags from both input DataFrames using AND logic
test_merge_propagates_metadata_from_equa: test that merge deep-copies attrs when both inputs have identical metadata dictionaries
test_merge_does_not_propagate_metadata_f: test that merge drops attrs when left and right inputs have different metadata dictionaries
